title: Really Inspired
description: Manage D&D 5e Inspiration using a shared or individual pool, with a configurable limit, chat-based transfer, and seamless synchronization with the system's native Inspiration.

recommends.reason: Optional: if active, the inspiration counter is shown through Tidy5e's own banked-inspiration UI instead of the default dnd5e sheet widget.
Optional: improves reliability of one specific case in shared mode - spending inspiration that currently belongs to another character.
